contracts.boundary: Real pinned Pi TUI offers a concise tool-generated summary without raw rule/model JSON or duplicate equivalent source/effective lists, or a user-selected sequential exact review before one guarded write. Summary accurately describes classifier enablement/disablement, lists every changed field, and flags first-match rule reordering and wholesale rule removal; layered source changes are distinguished from unchanged effective behavior. Ordinary and narrow viewports show navigable bounded summaries; exact review displays the full 6,000-character value and suffix. Summary Apply is explicit; exact-view Apply is gated to its final rendered page. Resize and cancellation fail closed.
contracts.assertions: Unit tests verify accurate classifier enablement/disablement wording; first-match rule reordering and multiset duplicate removals; scalar model pools; legacy models.description tiers versus schema-v3 description metadata; every changed field name; concise counts; no raw rule/model values; source/effective deltas; and retention of unrelated policy in an added-tier candidate. Skill packaging test checks preserve-and-compare guidance, its advisory status, and the 2,000,000-character fail-closed path. Real Pi PTY verifies classifier enablement, rule priority change, all changed field names, concise impact for wholesale rule removal, pool/fallback counts, ordinary/narrow navigation and layered edits masked by project policy. It also selects exact review, confirms early exact Apply writes nothing, verifies the entire 6,000-character value across pages, cancels safely, applies exact after resize reset, and separately applies from summary. Isolated Pi fault copy suppresses classifier summary and must fail the real-Pi display assertion. Current Pi's `ctx.ui.editor` edits supplied text via a temporary editor file; it has no API to open the saved config path. No post-apply editor action is offered because editing a copy would need a validated, re-approved write/reload roundtrip.

boundaryTest.name: requires complete paged approval in real pinned Pi across viewport resize

invariant.name: reports first-match rule reorder and duplicate multiplicity changes

fault.name: detects a faulty summary that hides classifier disablement in an isolated Pi copy
